K_semantics: Total requested spectral-kmeans components per family. Small clusters <3 dropped as original code. Both K reported; no selection.
covariance_shrinkage: Fixed to each family's final historical selected shrinkage for both K; no new validation selection.
original_selected_oracle: Also report six original selected configurations, including five-subtype K=320, separately from fixed spectral K=64/256.
oracle_candidate_universe: Original run_oracles.py last version; no new prior form or candidate selection.

unknown_family.family_universe: Six listed families, equal family weights 1/6, all within-family weights retained.
unknown_family.K: Same frozen K=64/256 spectral prior files as known-family oracle.
unknown_family.noise: Estimate covariance using only archived VSEED=31438 repeated real readings and known calibration spectra. No new evaluation labels, amplitudes, powers, or DEVCOV passed.
unknown_family.estimator: For each old calibration spectrum regress unit-area readings onto [R*x, dark/||dark||]. Estimate white variance from residual RSS/(n-2). Estimate dark-direction variance as mean squared fitted dark coefficient minus white coefficient variance; clip at zero. Freeze before evaluation.
unknown_family.boundary: Calibration is at historical nominal operating conditions. This does not establish robustness to a new power distribution or arbitrary 26-family inputs.

bootstrap.scope: Four target families separately per method comparison; not simultaneous over all methods and K.
bootstrap.stable_improvement: upper corrected log CI <0 and paired geometric ratio <=0.95

restrictions: No fitting/choice using 31451 or 63862; 31451 only a locked reproduction gate and retrospective statistics. Never load/generate 6161/4242 or load 81063 results. No B1/B3 decision.
reproduction_gate: All six families, all five old main-table methods: absolute mean NRMSE difference <1e-6; otherwise stop without generating 63862.
